# This directory holds TLS certificates for local development trust.
# 
# Run deploy/docker/scripts/setup-dev-mssql-cert.sh once to populate mssql-dev.crt.
# The certificate is not a secret — it can be committed once generated.
#
# Files in this directory:
#   mssql-dev.crt   — SQL Server self-signed cert for dev containers (generated by script)
